script.opening_words: Ever scrolled through social media and wondered how that guy from high school is posting vacation photos from the Maldes while you're celebrating because your checking account finally hit four digits. Or maybe you've heard someone throw around terms like top 1% and wondered if you'd even qualify for the top 90%. Well, today we're going to pull back the curtain on what it actually means to be rich in America. And I guarantee some of these numbers are going
script.ending_words: buy today that they never consider what money could become tomorrow. So, there you have it. The real breakdown of what being rich actually means in America. Whether you're celebrating that fourdigit checking account or already planning your yacht purchase, now you know exactly where you stand and what it takes to climb higher. The choice is yours. Keep chasing the appearance of wealth or start building the real thing.
script.analysis: Full 19092 canonical characters read. A single-narrator explainer: social-comparison hook, rich vs wealthy framing, household income thresholds by percentile, individual top 1%, net worth thresholds (median, under-35, 25/10/5/1%), life at each tier, $2M vs $20M lifestyles, lifestyle inflation, rich vs wealthy, tier-specific strategies, the $3M vs $300,000 career comparison, money psychology and a close. Net-worth figures match SCF 2022; income thresholds below the median are unsourced; much of the second half is generic advice.
